signals.label: Lifetime definition
signals.finding: The vendor may discontinue the product, which ends a lifetime deal.

evidence.quote: (f) Skillplate decides to discontinue or materially change the Services.

signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage.

evidence.quote: - Unlimited Products - Unlimited Bundles - Unlimited Communities - Unlimited Websites - Unlimited Landing pages - Unlimited Emails - Unlimited Automations

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The cheapest tier is a usable slice of the product.

signals.label: Vendor age & track record
signals.finding: Domain is about 8.2 years old. Sold on AppSumo 2 times before.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $79 vs a stated $948 regular price (92% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

evidence.quote: Skillplate may modify, improve, replace, remove, or update any part of the Platform at any time.
Prices, plan limits, usage limits, included features, and billing terms may vary and may be changed by Skillplate from time to time.

trials.claim: Deal includes all future Starter, Basic, Growth or Pro plan updates
trials.claimQuote: All future Starter (Tier 1), Basic (Tier 2-3), Growth (Tier 4) or Pro (Tier 5) Plan updates
trials.reasoning: The terms only reserve a general right to change features or prices; they do not say lifetime deal buyers are excluded from future plan updates, and no exhibit confirms the deal inclusion.

exhibits.quote: Prices, plan limits, usage limits, included features, and billing terms may vary and may be changed by Skillplate from time to time.
exhibits.argument: The vendor reserves the right to change prices, limits and included features at any time, which undermines a promise of all future plan updates.

exhibits.quote: Skillplate may modify, improve, replace, remove, or update any part of the Platform at any time.
exhibits.argument: The vendor can remove or replace any part of the platform at any time, which voids assurance of future updates.

trials.claim: Talk to the AI agent Overmind to build products, website, checkout and campaigns from one platform
trials.claimQuote: Talk to the AI agent, Overmind, to build products, a website, checkout, and campaigns from one platform
trials.reasoning: The vendor states Overmind builds products with content, cover and landing page, and describes one platform to create, sell and grow a business; the generic AI-accuracy disclaimer and a review confirming AI course-building do not materially undercut that.

exhibits.quote: AI-assisted output may be inaccurate, incomplete, generic, unsuitable, or legally insufficient.
exhibits.argument: The vendor disclaims AI accuracy and suitability, undermining the claim of building products, website, checkout and campaigns via Overmind.

exhibits.quote: There is some AI that will build out a complete course for you if you just type in the name of the course
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports AI only builds a basic course from a name, not a full business with website, checkout and campaigns.

exhibits.quote: Overmind AI builds any product you want, with the content, cover and landing page ready in minutes.
exhibits.argument: This confirms the vendor's own Overmind AI builds products with content and landing page.

exhibits.quote: One platform to create, sell, and grow your digital business from start to finish.
exhibits.argument: This confirms the vendor promises creating, selling and growing a business from one platform.

trials.claim: Seller provides fully agentic AI that turns a prompt into an operational business
trials.claimQuote: Skillplate gives you access to fully agentic AI that can turn a prompt into an operational business and help you grow it step by step.
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes a single AI platform to create a website and manage an entire business, and an AI that analyzes customers and sales then launches optimizations; the terms only disclaim guaranteed accuracy or success, not the existence of these agentic functions.

exhibits.quote: Skillplate does not guarantee that AI-generated content will be accurate, compliant, original, commercially successful, or fit for your purpose.
exhibits.argument: The vendor disclaims any guarantee that AI output will be successful or fit for purpose, contradicting fully agentic prompt-to-business.

exhibits.quote: AI-assisted output may be inaccurate, incomplete, generic, unsuitable, or legally insufficient.
exhibits.argument: The vendor warns AI output may be generic and unsuitable, undermining turn-a-prompt-into-operational-business.

exhibits.quote: Create a website to sell digital products or services & manage your entire business with a single AI platform.
exhibits.argument: This confirms the vendor offers a single AI platform to create and manage an entire business.

exhibits.quote: Your growth partner that analyzes customers and sales, then launches optimizations in minutes.
exhibits.argument: This confirms the vendor describes its AI as acting on business data to launch optimizations.

trials.claim: Seller offers courses, communities, coaching, services, memberships and downloads from a single storefront
trials.claimQuote: Offer courses, communities, coaching programs, services, memberships, and downloads from a single storefront
trials.reasoning: Two consistent buyer reviews state communities are hosted externally on Discord and are only on Discord, which materially limits the claim that communities are offered from the single storefront, outweighing the one contrary review.

exhibits.quote: Caution : Communities are to be hosted externally on Discord.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports communities are not in the single storefront but hosted externally on Discord.

exhibits.quote: Communities, as of now, are only on Discord.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms native single-platform communities do not exist yet, contradicting the single-storefront offer.

exhibits.quote: Skillplate brings courses, communities, memberships, and digital products together in one platform, with AI tools to help create content and build your website.
exhibits.argument: This buyer confirms courses, communities, memberships and digital products are together in one platform.

exhibits.quote: Sell coaching and consulting with easy booking and flexible schedule management.
exhibits.argument: This confirms the vendor offers coaching and services selling with booking on the platform.
